product_one_liner.value: Fluxco helps utilities, developers and EPCs procure transformers by connecting their specifications with competitive bids from a global network of more than 150 manufacturers.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link appears in the site navigation or footer, and no public pricing page was retrieved at /pricing; buyers are directed to specifications and quotes.

named_customers.notes: Could not establish two named customers; no matching customer case-study or review listing was found. Investors and manufacturers were not counted.

employee_band.notes: Based on a reported employee count of 13.

eng_blog.notes: The resource index contains transformer buyer guides, equipment explainers and industry commentary, not posts about building Fluxco's software.

public_docs.notes: The public navigation provides an FAQ but no documentation site, help center or developer portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live posting is titled Full-Stack Software Engineer (AI-Native Generalist), qualifying under the requested AI-in-title criterion; it is a generalist software role rather than a dedicated ML research position.

model_provider.notes: No product model provider was publicly identified in the FAQ, resources, privacy policy or terms reviewed. Claude Code, Cursor and Codex are mentioned as engineering tools, not as providers powering the product.

compliance_certs.notes: The legal pages reviewed name none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS.

last_funding.notes: Reported as approximately $26 million, led by Congruent Ventures and 8VC.

raised_18mo.notes: The July 2026 seed round falls within the 18-month window; the founder's launch announcement also confirms closing the $26 million round.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Account Executive (Data Centers) posting is live; the careers index also lists Enterprise Account Executive positions.

launched_6mo.notes: A founder's LinkedIn announcement says Fluxco is officially launched and describes its transformer procurement platform. The retrieved post displays an age of 3mo, placing it within the six-month window; an exact calendar date was not confirmed.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Brian Tochman's profile dates the start of his Founder and CEO role at FluxCo to January 2026, within the 12-month window; this is profile-based rather than a separate hiring announcement.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The sales posting requires keeping the CRM updated but does not name the system.
